subject.title: feat(onboard): streamline setup with agent-assisted configuration

question: Should the installed official-plugin trust predicate be tightened and shared with the channel catalog so verified installed channels inherit repository-owned labels and documentation paths?
rationale: The implementation is fail-closed, but adding a trusted consumer and changing accepted path relationships are permanent security and compatibility policy choices that code review alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve strict shared trust
options.body: Keep the tighter current-install-path predicate and authorize channel metadata only after every identity, ledger, source, and path check passes.

options.title: Keep manifest-only trust
options.body: Add metadata only for bundled and catalog-only entries without authorizing installed plugin re-linking.

options.title: Split the policy changes
options.body: Separate the public JSON addition from the trust tightening and new consumer for independent owner review.

recommendation.title: Approve strict shared trust
recommendation.body: Keep the tighter current-install-path predicate and authorize channel metadata only after every identity, ledger, source, and path check passes.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main trust implementation originates in this person's recent merged work, making them the strongest code-boundary owner for confirming semantic compatibility.
